title: Set a project parameter and refresh the Projects panel
summary: Lists the focused project's parameters with DM_Parameters and changes one by name or index with DM_SetValue, followed by DM_RefreshInWorkspaceForm; documents that the change does not mark the project modified.
phrasings: update a PrjPcb parameter from code
refresh the Projects panel after a change

commands.name: SetProjectParameter
commands.description: Set a project parameter (by Name, or by 0-based Index, default 0) to Value (default KKKKEEE) and refresh the Projects panel

commands.name: ListProjectParameters
commands.description: List the parameters of the focused project
